title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Mock 01
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Tub coupling must be
questions.solution: Checked before every trip.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Permit to work for hazardous tasks includes
options: A phone call to the manager
questions.solution: Authorization, hazards, PPE.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Exit' in underground mines under Mines Rules must be
options: Available and maintained for use during emergencies
questions.solution: Emergency exits must be available and maintained for worker evacuation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face profile' after blasting indicates
options: The effectiveness of the blast in breaking the rock face
questions.solution: Face profiles indicate blast effectiveness in rock breakage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water-filled blasting holes require special consideration because
options: Water has no effect on blasting
Water can desensitize certain explosives and affect initiation
questions.solution: Water can desensitize explosives and interfere with initiation, requiring water-resistant products.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'conveyor system' in opencast mining is preferred over trucks when
options: Distance is long and material volume is high
questions.solution: Conveyors are preferred for long distances with high material volumes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Geotextiles in reclamation are used for
options: Soil stabilization and erosion control on slopes
Diverting seepage water away from the benches
questions.solution: Geotextiles provide immediate erosion control on slopes while vegetation establishes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A safety suggestion scheme in mines encourages
options: All workers to report hazards and suggest safety improvements
questions.solution: Safety suggestion schemes empower all workers to contribute to safety improvements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: PPE inspection should be
questions.solution: Before each use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Roof Inspection' in underground mines must be conducted
options: At least once every three months
After a roof fall has occurred in the workings
Before each shift by a competent person
questions.solution: Roof inspections must be done before each shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'succession planning' in reclamation vegetation involves
options: Planning for natural progression from pioneer to climax species
Replanting the same crop every year
questions.solution: Succession planning guides vegetation from initial colonizers to stable communities.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Machine marching means
questions.solution: Relocating equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Accident Investigation Committee' under CMR 2017 includes
options: Representatives of the owner, workers, and the Inspector of Mines
questions.solution: The committee must include owner, worker, and Inspector of Mines representatives.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Section 7 of the Mines Act 1952 deals with
questions.solution: Section 7 of the Mines Act 1952 deals with regulation of hours of work above ground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Equipment Utilization Report includes
questions.solution: Availability, utilization, maintenance, fuel.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Rules 1955 requires that the 'Manriding System' in shafts must be
options: Approved by the Chief Inspector of Mines
questions.solution: Manriding systems in shafts must be approved by the Chief Inspector of Mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Ramp Width' in opencast mines must accommodate
questions.solution: Ramp widths must accommodate two-way traffic with safe clearances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'quantitative analysis' in reports uses
options: Statistical and numerical data to support findings
questions.solution: Quantitative analysis uses numerical data and statistics for evidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'data visualization' in reports serves to
options: Add decorative images to the report
Present complex data in an understandable visual format
questions.solution: Data visualization presents complex information clearly through charts and graphs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'safety leadership program' for supervisors focuses on
options: Leading by example and promoting safety culture
questions.solution: Safety leadership programs develop supervisors' ability to promote safety culture.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'end effect' in shovel operation refers to
options: The end of the mine life
Reduced efficiency at the ends of the shovel's swing arc
questions.solution: End effect refers to reduced efficiency due to limited swing angles at the ends of the shovel's working arc.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Advance rate' is
questions.solution: Lateral progression rate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'residual value' of an opencast mine is the
options: Estimated value of remaining extractable minerals
questions.solution: Residual value represents the estimated worth of remaining extractable minerals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Confinement comes from
questions.solution: Hole walls and stemming.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Haul road surface is made of
options: Mixture of sand and dry clay only
questions.solution: Compacted earth, gravel, or laterite.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Emulsion VOD is typically

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The report of a sirdar's examination under CMR 2017 shall be recorded in:
options: A bound paged book in the prescribed format
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: results are recorded in a bound paged book kept for the purpose, in the prescribed format, signed and dated.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Sirdar under CMR 2017 must hold
options: A certificate issued by the contractor
questions.solution: Valid DGMS certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a reclamation technique?
questions.solution: Blasting is a mining activity, not a reclamation technique.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Shift handover under Rules includes
options: Names of workers reporting for the shift
questions.solution: Conditions, hazards, pending.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Evacuation Route' at opencast mines must be
options: Clearly marked, maintained, and accessible at all times
questions.solution: Evacuation routes must be clearly marked and always accessible.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Reactive indicators include
questions.solution: Injuries, fatalities, damage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Explosive strength measured by
options: Colour and appearance of the explosive
Size and shape of the package
questions.solution: Energy output.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The purpose of a roof inspection report in underground mines is to
options: Record roof conditions, support status, and any signs of instability
questions.solution: Roof inspection reports document conditions, support effectiveness, and instability indicators.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Land capability assessment determines
options: Volume of the mined out void
questions.solution: Potential uses of reclaimed land.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: DGMS is the statutory body under which Act?
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blast vibration controlled by
options: Delay timing, charge per delay, distance
questions.solution: Timing, charge, distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Rules 1955 specifies the minimum illumination levels for different areas of mines
options: Yes, with different requirements for different areas
Applied uniformly in every part of the mine
questions.solution: Mines Rules specify minimum illumination requirements for different mine areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Soil compaction is caused by
questions.solution: Heavy equipment traffic.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Rules 1955 requires that the 'Safety Lamp' must be examined
options: Before each use by a competent person
questions.solution: Safety lamps must be examined by a competent person before each use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Deep ripping breaks
options: Hard rock strata at shallow depth
questions.solution: Compacted layers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Signage' at opencast mine haul roads must include
options: Warning signs, speed limits, and directional signs
questions.solution: Haul roads must have comprehensive signage including warnings, speeds, and directions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The statutory plan of workings report must show
options: All working places, roadways, shafts, and their spatial relationship
The boundaries of the lease area and the surface arrangements
questions.solution: Plans must show all working places and their spatial relationships for safety and regulatory purposes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Cushion blasting protects
questions.solution: Final wall.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A condition report for mining equipment should include
options: Current condition, maintenance history, defects found, and recommended actions
questions.solution: Condition reports must document current state, maintenance history, defects, and action recommendations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Manager inspection frequency is
options: Immediately after every accident or dangerous occurrence
questions.solution: Daily or at prescribed intervals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Electronic detonators offer advantage over pyrotechnic detonators by providing
options: Precise timing accuracy for better blast results
questions.solution: Electronic detonators provide millisecond-accurate timing for optimized fragmentation and reduced vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Overburden Dump Slope' design must consider
options: Material properties, groundwater, and long-term stability
questions.solution: Dump slope design considers material, water, and stability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a sirdar is required to be posted at a station designated by which person?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: the manager fixes the STATION posts and the sirdar is posted there during his shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: High-vis clothing is required for
questions.solution: All personnel in active areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Falling object protection in opencast mines requires
options: Hard hats, exclusion zones, and barricading of hazard areas
questions.solution: Protection requires hard hats, exclusion zones, and barricading of dangerous areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Hazardous Area' demarcation at opencast mines requires
options: Clear boundaries, signage, and access control
questions.solution: Hazardous areas need clear demarcation and access control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, when must a sirdar carry out the first examination of a place before work is commenced in it?
options: At the exact time of commencement of work
At least 2 hours before commencement of work
Within 2 hours before commencement of work
At least 1 hour before commencement of work
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: the first examination shall be carried out within 2 hours before the commencement of work in the place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: First Aid Box contains
questions.solution: Prescribed items.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Acid mine drainage (AMD) affects reclamation by
options: Lowering pH and making soil toxic for plants
questions.solution: AMD produces acidic, metal-laden water that is toxic to plants and must be treated for reclamation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Trim blasting uses
options: Full column charges in the hole
questions.solution: Reduced charges with tight spacing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Accident record must include
options: Date, time, location, persons, cause, action
questions.solution: Comprehensive details.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Wildlife habitat creation on reclaimed mine land may include
options: Planting native species, creating water features, and brush piles
questions.solution: Habitat creation uses native plants, water features, and shelter structures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Plan' under CMR 2017 must be reviewed
options: Whenever a new manager takes charge of the mine
At least once a year and after any significant incident
questions.solution: Emergency plans must be reviewed annually and after any significant incident.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Gas testing certificate ensures ability to
options: Test for methane and hazardous gases
questions.solution: Test for methane and hazardous gases.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mine void water quality monitoring is essential for
options: Assessing environmental impact and potential reuse
questions.solution: Water quality monitoring assesses environmental impact and determines reuse potential.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Roof Inspector' in underground mines must report to
options: The mine manager and Safety Committee
questions.solution: Roof inspectors must report to both the mine manager and Safety Committee.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'benchmarking section' in reports compares
options: Performance or results against industry standards or best practices
questions.solution: Benchmarking compares results against industry standards or best practices.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosive column height' affects
options: Energy distribution and fragmentation along the borehole
questions.solution: Column height affects energy distribution and fragmentation quality.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, 'Support' in underground mines refers to
options: Structural elements to maintain stability of workings
questions.solution: Support refers to structural elements maintaining stability of underground workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Regulation 132 of CMR 2017 deals with
options: Payment of royalty to the state
questions.solution: Regulation 132 deals with fire prevention and protection measures in mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, how often must a sirdar re-examine a place during a shift where work is going on?
options: Once at the middle of the shift only
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: every such place shall be re-examined at least once in every 4 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Water Gauge' reading in ventilation must be recorded
options: At the end of the financial year
Whenever the ventilation system is overhauled
questions.solution: Water gauge readings must be recorded at least once every shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Subsidence monitoring detects
questions.solution: Ground movement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sub-drilling' in blast holes is done to
options: Ensure the explosive charge reaches below the planned floor level
questions.solution: Sub-drilling ensures proper breakage at the planned floor level.
